title: SWE-Duel：面向编码智能体的自扩展竞技场
summary: 提出SWE-Duel自扩展基准，任务与判定在评测时动态生成，避免数据泄漏与饱和。通过红蓝对抗让两个编码智能体互相出题与修复，在11个模型、15个仓库、1500轮对战中验证，任务难度随出题能力提升而扩展。
summary_en: SWE-Duel introduces a self-scaling arena where two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns, generating tasks and oracles at evaluation time to avoid leakage and saturation. A 1,500-turn tournament across 11 model-harness participants and 15 repositories shows task difficulty scales with authoring capability.
